verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents individual features (function calling, agents, handoffs, structured outputs) and a 'first API request' quickstart, but nothing shows an official cookbook or worked end-to-end example a developer could adapt. The quickstart is a single-call starting point, and feature descriptions such as agent handoffs describe capabilities, not worked examples. One community report mentions an inaccessible notebook link, which is not affirmative evidence of usable cookbooks.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
